snippet.title: Sol and the Endless Orbit Demo (Steam Trailer)
snippet.description:
A story-rich, not-quite-turn-based hybrid of RPG strategy and real-time platforming. Secure the future of the galaxy's vibrant settings and whimsical inhabitants... or uncover the secrets at the center of everything, and draw a different path.

Play the demo and wishlist here! → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4133460/Sol_and_the_Endless_Orbit/
Or play it here! → https://coolguybug.itch.io/sol-and-the-endless-orbit
And check out the website! → https://solandtheendlessorbit.com/
Also join the Discord! → https://discord.com/invite/TDkpWZbsK3
